title: Perform CALPHAD equilibrium calculations
action: Use OpenCalphad with a Fe‑based thermodynamic database to compute equilibrium phase fractions and compositions (wt% Cr, Mo, N) of ferrite (BCC) and austenite (FCC) at temperatures 1050, 1100, 1150, 1200 °C for the UNS S31803 bulk composition. Save the extracted data as a structured file.

title: Compute PREN values
action: From the equilibrium phase compositions, calculate PREN = %Cr + 3.3 × %Mo + 16 × %N for ferrite and austenite at each temperature. Write the results to pren_results.csv under /app/outputs.
description: File containing the computed PREN and the underlying phase compositions for ferrite and austenite at each solution treatment temperature.
output_schema: Columns: Temperature (int, °C), Phase (string, 'ferrite' or 'austenite'), Cr_wt (float, wt%), Mo_wt (float, wt%), N_wt (float, wt%), PREN (float, dimensionless). One row per phase per temperature, 8 rows total.
